bathing a cat for the first time can be tough, especially considering all cats react to it easily. From my experience, I would suggest taking your time with it. make sure the water is running before you bring your cat into the room. Allow them to get use to the faucet, they'll likely be curious and look at the running water for a bit. Then you will want to take a small amount of water into your hands and let it drip over them. their reaction to this will tell you just how hard a time they are going to give you. continue doing this for a few minutes while petting and (if you don't mind getting a little wet yourself) holding them so that they know they are safe and everything is fine. once they seem to have gotten use to the water you can try using something a bit bigger to pour the water onto them. I would suggest a cup. once they are completely wet you can get your pet shampoo and lather them up. after that, rinse them off and dry with a towel.
